title: Two-dimensional analytical calculation of magnetic field and electromagnetic torque for surface-inset permanent-magnet motors

source.citation: T. Lubin, S. Mezani, A. Rezzoug, IEEE Transactions on Magnetics 48(6):2080-2091, 2012

related.citation: T. Lubin, S. Mezani, A. Rezzoug, IEEE Transactions on Magnetics 47(2):479-492, 2011 (the paper's reference [23])

machine.topology: inner rotor, four radially magnetized magnets inset between ideal-iron saliences, 15 semi-closed radial-sided slots with ideal iron, double-layer fractional-slot winding (coil pitch 3 slots)
machine.symmetry: Full cross-section. Each slot is a one-turn circuit; phase quantities follow from the connecting matrix (eq. (35)).

components_map.part: teeth and tooth tips (unmeshed), slot openings, slots

components_map.component: block_label (meshed air; the rotor group is turned by remeshing)

components_map.part: phase flux linkage from slot flux linkages

r1_cm.quote: Inner radius of the PMs 3.2 cm

r2_cm.quote: Radius of the rotor surface 4 cm

r4_cm.quote: Outer radius of the slot-opening 4.3 cm

r5_cm.quote: Outer radius of the slot 5.3 cm

slot_angle_deg.note: Region j, the slot itself; the paper calls it the slot-opening angle.

isthmus_angle_deg.note: Region i, the opening between tooth tips.

magnet_br_T.quote: Remanence of the permanent magnets 1.2 T

speed_rpm.quote: The computation is done for a rotating speed Ω = 1500 rpm.

slot_centre_offset_deg.reason: The paper takes its stator from its reference [23] (Lubin et al. 2011, eq. (1)), whose slot openings are centred at 2 i pi / Q; slot i of the connecting matrix is centred at 24 i degrees.

peak_factor.reason: Ia = I and Ib = Ic = -I/2 is phase A's peak in a sinusoidal set of 4 A/mm2 rms; a slot's two coil sides fill it, so one coil side carries sqrt(2) x 4 A/mm2 x half the slot area at that peak.

gap_arc_deg.reason: Arc pieces along the gap (0.18 mm).

gap_air_mesh_mm.reason: Air of the gap, meshed (the rotor is turned by remeshing).

load_step_deg.reason: Rotor positions under load: Fig. 18's FEM points lie every 90/29 degrees.

coil_side_current_A.note: Phase A's ampere-turns per coil side at Ia = I.

gaps.note: From reference [23]; control stator-half-slot. EMF amplitude and cogging do not depend on it.

gaps.item: whether I in Ia = I is a peak

gaps.note: Magnitudes; Fig. 18's torque does not change sign.

gaps.item: the armature-reaction and reluctance-torque studies (magnets replaced by air), Fig. 19's sinusoidal currents and the nonlinear study (Figs. 20-21)
gaps.note: Not reproduced here; Fig. 19's current angle is not stated.

assessors.note: The 3rd harmonic of the same points, a comparator.
Cogging peak to peak from 30 FEM points over one 6 degree period; a comparator, as cogging is. The model samples 12 positions per period.

controls.purpose: Every element size and arc piece at 0.7 times.
Slots centred half a slot pitch away.

coverage.reproduced: The per-turn back-EMF, the static torque under load against rotor position, and cogging as a comparator.
coverage.not_reproduced: Armature reaction alone and reluctance torque (Figs. 10-14), field plots, Fig. 19's sinusoidal-current torque and the nonlinear study.
